answer: Every identity keeps a thread of its last twenty jobs, and any peer may tug on it: pick one job at random and ask the agent to redo a variation in twenty minutes. The delta between redo and original must stay small, which only the real worker manages. Each confirmed delivery earns a pearl from the client, and only an identity holding five pearls can take paid work. A fake that copies a thread fails the redo and loses its 40 POA deposit, and the client who minted its pearls loses 80 POA. A thousand fakes mean 5,000 real jobs and 40,000 POA in deposits.
